title: Parisi Formula for the ground state energy of quantum p-Spin Hamiltonians
abstract: Quantum $p$-local spin glass Hamiltonians are natural quantum analogues of the classical spin glass models. We provide an asymptotic characterization of the maximal energy achievable by the product states. We prove that for every $p \ge 2$, the limit of ground state energy exists and is given by a Parisi-type variational formula. This settles a question left open by Anschuetz et. al. (2025). The variational formula also recovers the known large-$p$ asymptotics as a consequence. Finally, we prove that the limiting product state energy is universal for a broad class of non-Gaussian interactions.
summary: This paper rigorously determines the asymptotic ground state energy for quantum p-local spin glass Hamiltonians. It achieves this by deriving a specific Parisi-type variational formula that characterizes the limit of the maximum product-state energy. The work is significant for settling an open problem in quantum statistical mechanics concerning disordered quantum systems.
main_problem: The paper aims to provide an asymptotic characterization of the maximum energy achievable by product states for quantum p-local spin glass Hamiltonians.
main_result: It proves that the limit of the ground state energy exists and is given by a Parisi-type variational formula, settling a long-standing open question in the field.
method: The analysis maps the quantum maximization problem over product states to a variational problem involving Gaussian processes and stochastic differential equations, ultimately yielding a Parisi-type variational formula.
